...What have you been looking at this 
whole time?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's a video endlessly following a Welsh 
Corgi's butt. When you don't want to use 
your brain, there's nothing better than 
this.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Videos of classic car engines running 
endlessly are also really nice, you 
know..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's usually tireless in her research on 
self-presentation, but she seems exhausted 
enough to want to rest her brain. It might 
be wise to review our upcoming schedule.
